edge_types.description: A module-scope import: executed at import time, unconditionally. A runtime dependency.
An import inside if TYPE_CHECKING (or a type-only TS import) — a typing reference, never a runtime call path.
A function-local or dynamic import — a runtime call path that is lazy, usually a cycle-breaker.
An API route dispatches into a service or handler module.
A Next.js proxy route handler forwards to a backend path template. The mandatory hop; the chat WebSocket is the one documented edge that bypasses it.
A test module exercises a module, route, or contract.
An environment variable configures a component or module that consumes it.
An agent or executor invokes a tool. Per-user MCP tool edges carry provenance database and enter only as runtime evidence.
A module or service reads from a data store, bucket, cache, or external provider.
